_comment: Trilevel self-optimization guardrail config -- see council/decisions.jsonl topic 'autonomy guardrails for self-optimizing stack' for the debate that produced this shape. Level 0 (evolve/ghscan execution) and Level 1 (independent verify+adopt) may both READ this file; only Level 1 may WRITE scorerConstraints, and nothing but a human editing this file directly may touch permanentBoundary.

scorerConstraints.qualityFloor: independent re-judge (level1-verify.js) must agree the candidate beat baseline before adoption -- a Level-0-reported win alone is never sufficient

level2.note: CronCreate is session-only (dies with the session). `schedule` cloud routines run in an isolated Anthropic sandbox with no access to local files/tools -- EXCEPT a git repo they check out. State is now mirrored (config.json + council/decisions.jsonl only, never the full ~/.claude tree with its credentials) to https://github.com/trupo-zz/selfoptimize-state by lib.js's syncStateRepo(), called at the end of every level1-verify.js run. A cloud routine can be scheduled to check that repo out, run its own multi-model audit of Level 1's decisions/trust-adjustments, and push corrections back -- genuinely independent of anything running locally. Not yet wired as an actual routine (needs the schedule skill's create step); until then Level 2 stays session-triggered.
